claim: Daily challenges roll over at 18:00 UTC (2pm Eastern in daylight time). On the morning of Wednesday 28 October 2026 the live Redux was still “Save the Forests” Redux, the Tuesday 27 October challenge, which first ran on 28 October 2025: 364 days earlier, on the same weekday.

evidence.reference: Maintainer report in the wiki session, 28 October 2026; batch date from the research repo's challenge archive capture (data/challenge-archive/2026-10-28/catalog.json).

notes: The report was 2pm Eastern, which was 18:00 UTC on that date. The wiki takes the rollover to be fixed at 18:00 UTC; after the US clocks change on 1 November 2026 that would be 1pm Eastern. If it still changes at 2pm Eastern, the rollover is 19:00 UTC in winter. Not yet checked.
